problems.title: Theorem B (1.20) fails for its full Sobolev-exponent range
problems.established_result: Admissible deterministic periodic layered coefficient with alpha=4/5,gamma=9/10,nu=1,beta=0 and smooth Dirichlet data yields an infinite H^{-1/10} gradient error for every fixed epsilon>0.
problems.proof: Complete analytic coefficient, law, coarse-ellipticity, weighted-density, Volterra-solution and dual-test proof; no finite computation substitutes for the universal conclusion.
problems.counterevidence: The example satisfies Omega, all stochastic hypotheses, U subset E1, smooth g and the exact weighted closure; Theorem A's uniform ellipticity is absent, so Theorem A is not refuted.
problems.core_impact: A principal quantified conclusion is false on admissible data.
problems.repair_boundary: Restrict topology/exponent or strengthen microscopic regularity. The written route needs s>gamma/2 and gamma<rho<2s; all scale/tail dependence has not been repaired.

problems.title: Lemma 2.6 large-contrast algebraic bounds are false
problems.established_result: s=tI,s*=I,k=(t-1)I/2 satisfies the full algebraic assumptions. At t=10 (2.81) asserts81<=18 and (2.82) asserts99<=54.
problems.proof: Exact rank-one positive difference and generalized spectrum1,t^2; actual exact-rational certificate.
problems.counterevidence: No coefficient-field realization is needed for this algebraic lemma. Intrinsic Theta=(t+1)^2/4 differs from tildeTheta=t, so (2.98) and all later field-dependent results are not thereby refuted.
problems.core_impact: False quantitative supporting lemma explicitly used in the renormalization framework.
problems.repair_boundary: Sharp upper bound t^2-1 and quadratic symmetric-k bound proved. Complete downstream propagation not verified.

problems.title: The additive Poisson model can be negative
problems.established_result: lambda=1/2,Lambda=1,rho1=0 and any rho2>0: exactly3 points in B_(r/2) and none else in B_(3r/2) makes a=-I/2 on B_(r/2) with explicit positive probability.
problems.proof: Analytic Poisson event and exact count arithmetic.
problems.counterevidence: Arbitrarily low positive intensity does not remove the event. No saturation convention is defined; AppendixD1 only changes radius.
problems.core_impact: Advertised example fails ambient ellipticity and the bounds used in its proof.
problems.repair_boundary: Boolean occupancy replacement restores pointwise [lambda,Lambda] bounds but changes the model; all quantitative claims for that model not fully rederived.

problems.title: Nonsymmetric matrix exponentiation does not give the claimed ellipticity
problems.established_result: g=F(I+J) has allowed Gaussian marginals but exp(hg) has negative symmetric part on a positive-measure set with positive probability. The accretive constant rotation family g_theta=theta J,0<theta<pi/2, fixed h=pi/2 also violates the uniform E0 bound inD3.
problems.proof: Matrix exponential identity; stationarity/Tonelli; exact constant-coarse sandwich and sec(theta) divergence.
problems.counterevidence: The positive rotation family belongs to Omega, so an implicit positivity restriction does not rescue the uniform D3 estimate.
problems.core_impact: Both the advertised class and its quantitative ellipticity verification fail.
problems.repair_boundary: Symmetry or a quantitative accretivity condition controlling s^{-1} is needed; remaining stochastic bounds not certified.

problems.title: Independent-sum tail (C.15) loses sample-size dependence
problems.established_result: Independent symmetric Weibull variables with sigma=3/2,m=100,t=10^8 have an explicit all-positive event more probable than either term of the stated upper bound.
problems.proof: Exact rational/integer comparisons of logarithms; actual reviewer-authored script exit0.
problems.counterevidence: This does not refute the weaker normalized(C.16) or the separate(C.31) argument; their exact constants were not re-proved.
problems.core_impact: A general probabilistic ingredient has a false large-deviation exponent in m; not repairable by a universal numerical constant.
problems.repair_boundary: Retain all m factors in the Chernoff product and reoptimize at t/m. No complete numerical replacement certified.

problems.title: Renormalization scale selection does not supply its stated premises
problems.established_result: Determinant root yields exponent-1/d, not-1. Printed N/h=3 versus23 required even before correction,45 after dimension correction in a concrete case. An arbitrarily-small-delta parameter family satisfies(3.5) but fails the strengthened(3.11), with a consistent constant-field witness.
problems.proof: Analytic determinant comparison, exact rational matrix sequence, exact q-family scalar bounds, and a positive-part iteration repair.
problems.counterevidence: The finite matrix sequence is not claimed realized by a random field. The constant-field witness satisfies Proposition3.3's conclusion. Fixed tolerance/exponents can retain log-squared contrast order conditional on the other steps.
problems.core_impact: The central one-step reduction is not established under its printed parameter and scale hypotheses.
problems.repair_boundary: Corrected block count and stronger scale requirement are supplied locally; full uniform-in-sigma bound and every renormalized parameter not restored.

problems.title: The printed fractional-field finite-range construction is invalid
problems.established_result: The nonnegative smooth cutoffs with annular lower indicators and sum1 cannot exist. The heat-convolution definition has full support and nonzero covariance at every separation, unlike the asserted compact product kernel. Entire scale fields driven by the same white noise are not independent.
problems.proof: Boundary jump contradiction, positive convolution covariance, translated-kernel overlap; explicit corrected cutoff/product construction with finite range, scaling and distributional convergence.
problems.counterevidence: Cross-scale independence is not required byD2/D4. A valid qualitative replacement exists. Proposition1.2 itself is not refuted.
problems.core_impact: The supplied argument does not establish the finite-range premise required in the Gaussian-field application.
problems.repair_boundary: Qualitative replacement proved; uniform sigma constants, mollified supremum bounds and external mixing not completely recertified.
